domain_facts.statement: TruckSetu is a freight and fleet company.
TruckSetu is in Pune.
TruckSetu has branches in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad.
The app must follow Indian transport and GST rules.
Your idea in one line: A freight and fleet app and portal for customers to book and track loads, staff to manage dispatch and trips, and teams to manage fleet and finance operations.
A customer (shipper) user is a platform role.
A customer admin is a platform role.
A dispatcher is a platform role.
A branch manager is a platform role.
A driver is a platform role.
A fleet maintenance manager is a platform role.
A workshop mechanic is a platform role.
A finance executive is a platform role.
A compliance officer is a platform role.
An operations head is a platform role.
A group administrator is a platform role.
Customers can register their company with a GST number and add users.
Customers can request a quote.
Customers can book a load with pickup and drop addresses, material, weight and date.
Customers can track a trip live on a map, see status updates and view delivery proof (POD).
Customers can download invoices and pay online.
Customers can raise a claim for damage or delay and see past bookings.
Dispatchers can see open bookings, assign trucks and drivers, and split or merge loads.
Dispatchers can see truck availability by branch, handle delays and breakdowns, reassign trips, and communicate with drivers.
Drivers can accept trips and navigate to pickup and drop.
Drivers can update trip status as reached, loaded, in transit or delivered.
Drivers can upload e-way bills, LR copies and POD photos.
Drivers can record fuel and toll expenses, request advances, see earnings and settlements, and report breakdowns or accidents.
Fleet maintenance can keep a truck register with RC, insurance, fitness, permit and PUC documents and expiry reminders.
Fleet maintenance can plan service schedules and raise workshop job cards.
Fleet maintenance can track spare parts and tyre life and see downtime.
Finance can create invoices with GST and e-invoicing and apply rate cards and surcharges.
Finance can reconcile payments, manage driver advances and settlements, export to Tally and see receivables ageing.
Compliance can track driver licences and medical checks, permit and insurance validity, and e-way bill validity.
The platform must provide an audit trail of who changed what.
Operations heads and group administrators can view dashboards across branches for trips, utilisation, on-time delivery and revenue per truck.
Operations heads and group administrators can manage branches, users and roles, and approval limits for discounts and refunds.

The platform integrates with GPS telematics devices for live location, FASTag toll data, the e-way bill portal, GST e-invoice portal, a payment gateway for UPI and cards, SMS and WhatsApp notifications, and Tally accounting.
Customers can see only their own bookings.
Drivers can see only their own trips.
Finance can see invoices but not driver personal documents.
Every change to a rate or trip assignment must be logged.
Documents are kept for 8 years.
Data stays in India.
The app works in English, Hindi and Marathi.
Fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.

Your idea in one line: It helps customers book and track freight loads, dispatchers assign our own and hired trucks and drivers, drivers record every trip with proof of delivery, and our fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.
We start in Pune and Mumbai, then roll out to Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad.
Our teams and drivers use English, Hindi and Marathi.
The customer pays TruckSetu per load.
The charge depends on distance, weight and truck type, with a rate card per customer and surcharges for waiting time and extra stops.
Large customers get a monthly contract.
TruckSetu pays hired trucks per trip.
TruckSetu settles its own drivers' advances and earnings.
Payment gateway
SMS and WhatsApp
Bookings come by phone and WhatsApp.
Customers keep calling to ask where their load is.
Dispatchers lose time matching trucks.
Drivers' papers and expenses arrive late.
The problem it solves: Bookings come by phone and WhatsApp, customers keep calling to ask where their load is, dispatchers lose time matching trucks, and drivers' papers and expenses arrive late.
Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are included in the freight charge for customers.
The app has no separate fee.
On-time delivery is the main result, increasing from about 82% to 92% in six months
The time a dispatcher spends assigning a load goes from 25 minutes to under 10
Kind of app: travel_hospitality
Kind of app: payments_wallet
Kind of app: delivery_logistics
How it earns money: Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are all included in the freight charge; nothing is billed separately for the app.
Many drivers use mid-range Android phones.
Many drivers have weak network on the road.
Country and city: At the branches in Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad, in the trucks on the road across India, and in customers' offices.
Who it is for: Customers and their admins, dispatchers, branch managers, drivers, fleet maintenance, finance, compliance, the operations head and the group administrator.
Country and city: India
